A: Until the first sale
B: Until the store covers your costs
C: Until your boss gets annoying

p.t: **Answer: B**, until the store covers your costs. Then pay yourself, and **reinvest the rest**.
p.v: Answer: B, until the store covers your costs. Then pay yourself, and reinvest the rest.
p.x: Answer: B, until the store covers your costs. Then pay yourself, and reinvest the rest.
